love.summary: Most readers see a meaningful new romantic connection on the horizon for Capricorn, so opening your heart and releasing past barriers will be key to welcoming something genuine and lasting.
love.disagreement: One reading leaned toward trusting intuition and using discernment rather than simply opening up, suggesting a more cautious approach to who earns a place in your life.

finance.summary: Financial efforts appear to be paying off this week, with material gains and rewards arriving as a result of past work, making it a strong time to take an active and confident role in managing your resources.
finance.disagreement: No notable disagreement among readers who discussed this theme.

career.summary: Most readers this week sense positive career movement for Capricorn, whether through a breakthrough, a passion-driven new path, or upward momentum, so channel your energy into what is genuinely working and be willing to let go of what is not.
career.disagreement: Some readers saw growth through staying the course and enjoying current fulfillment, while others suggested cutting ties with unproductive efforts and starting fresh independently.

family.summary: Family and close relationships are a central theme this week, with most readers pointing to a meaningful moment of connection, decision, or realignment, so trust your instincts and tend to the relationships and spaces that support your growth.
family.disagreement: Some readers saw a joyful reunion or deepened bond with a loved one, while others suggested a draining connection may need boundaries or an ending.

overall_tone_summary: A quietly bright week, with optimism threading through even the reflective moments. Second week running.

readers.channel_theme: Soulmate-level love and financial rewards exceeding expectations are both highlighted.
A reunion with someone long absent is the emotional centerpiece this week.
